advice:
In this course, students work on original themes related to their specialized fields using the abilities they have acquired thus far at KIT.

In the process, students will learn the techniques of problem finding and solving, while receiving consultations and advice from their faculty advisers.

Design Project III is a full-year course, so students are required to make appropriate plans to accomplish their set objectives autonomously.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students work on original themes related to their specialized fields using the abilities they have acquired thus far at KIT.

In the process, students will learn the techniques of problem finding and solving, while receiving consultations and advice from their faculty advisers.

Design Project III is a full-year course, so students are required to make appropriate plans to accomplish their set objectives autonomously.
